segments.name: digital payments
segments.description: Operates a two-sided digital payments network, giving consumers wallets and credit and merchants checkout, payment processing and payout solutions.
segments.evidence: Our products are designed to enable digital payments and simplify commerce experiences for consumers and merchants to make selling, shopping, and sending and receiving money simple, personalized, and secure, whether online or in-person.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay PayPal fees for completing payment transactions and other payment-related services, typically based on processed volume.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn revenues primarily by charging fees for completing payment transactions for our customers and other payment-related services
